answer: A resold ticket carries a provenance record showing every resale with price and parties, and the vault of the design is that the provenance must be complete back to the original sale. The opal of the scheme is that a ticket with a gap in its provenance is treated as suspect and held at the door. A Sybil cannot duplicate a ticket and sell both copies, because the vine of the provenance allows only one unbroken chain per serial.
